title: Mixed Event — Tied By Painful Hope — Episode5 I've Got a Bad Feeling

meta.Episode: Episode5 — I've Got a Bad Feeling
meta.Event Outline: With their new outfits completed, MORE MORE JUMP! next gets someone to help create an original song for their next show. The composer gets to work, but then faces some troubles...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
Today's the day we get Hasegawa's demo!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's been bouncing off the walls like this for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Because it's our very own song!
I can't wait to hear what it's like!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, I've got mail...
From Hasegawa.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
Does that mean our original song's...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But there's no file attached...
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I apologize for being unable to deliver your demo to you as planned today. I'm going to need a little more time.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I promise to finish it, so I hope you'll bear with me for just a bit longer.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's hard to say.
I really hope she's feeling well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She could just be busy dealing with the response to the Yuporin dance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She promised to finish it, so let's give her some time.

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: That means they're gonna be really famous! I mean, Yuporin's using their song!

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: That's like five million followers right there. Imagine what's gonna happen when other people start posting their own content using this song.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, but would you three be okay with starting practice without me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's something I need to look up. I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright...
In that case, let's start with some strength training!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But let's start by looking at that song's video. Down to the comments section...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I came here after seeing the Yuporin dance! This song's so good!>
<I'm never gonna get tired of this.>
<Masterpiece.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Alright, a lot of positive comments as I saw before...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I swear I've heard this before somewhere.>
<Yeah, did they copy someone else?>
<Wait, they stole this?>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yuporin, don't use this poser's song...>
<LOL! The part about “spreading hope” in the overview.>
<Hope as in going viral by copying someone else?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I knew it...
It's not just this video. People are saying the same thing on TrickTrick and PicShare.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Anyone would be happy about getting this much attention for something they did...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But not everyone watching or listening is going to have her best interests in mind. Some will simply have a different opinion, but others will have less wholesome intentions.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The more attention and positive comments someone receives, others begin writing more of these kinds of remarks. If Hasegawa's already seen these comments...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I had to go through a lot when I first debuted too...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Some criticized me for not smiling enough, some called me a terrible dancer, and some even claimed that I used my agency connections to get where I was...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm used to it now, but it felt so awful back then. No matter how hard I tried, it was like no one would acknowledge me as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This may very well be the first time Hasegawa's received so much attention...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry about that..!
I know we need to start practice, but mind looking at this for me really quick?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Stolen...?
I seriously doubt she'd ever do that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
I mean, the melodies Hasegawa can come up with are all so sparkly and dazzling!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There's no way you can come up with that by copying someone else...!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: All to spread hope to others the way ASRUN did with me...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: So I decided that I also want to write songs that can give someone hope...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can't spread hope to others by copying someone else. Hasegawa must already know that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, I'm surprised by how people have been going after creators like this lately.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This song blowing up overnight's probably why it's attracting so many jealous or prickly people.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you think these negative comments are having an effect on Hasegawa...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How can people write such awful things...? On top of hurting the people they write about, they don't really benefit from writing these mean things.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't like it either, but I kinda see where they're coming from...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's sad, but people become jealous of others when they see them succeed instead of themselves...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, that's no reason to hurt someone like this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... Yeah...
This just reminded me what happened way back when.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Remember what everyone used to say about me not so long ago?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<One of these girls is not like the others.>
<What's she doing here with Haruka and company?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I really couldn't do anything compared to the rest of you, so I was prepared to see people write those sorts of comments...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, it's hard not to feel even a little deflated when they say stuff like that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I'm wondering if Hasegawa's going through what I did back then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, what if we all gave her a call...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think we should start by seeing how she really feels.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've speculated for a while about her, but what if we're getting the wrong idea?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right...
But she could be stressing over what we were just talking about. What do you plan on doing if that's the case?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, we'll just have to help her deal with that pain.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's never easy for any one person to have to carry this sort of weight.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just after I first debuted, I remember hearing a lot of terrible things being said about me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But my group was there to help me through that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hasegawa's one of us now, so we should be there for her during her time of need.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, we've all gone through something like this at some point. I'm no exception to that fact.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Popular idols like you two, Shizuku, Haruka... Or rather, idols who are known throughout Japan are bound to attract some unsavory customers.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I'm so sorry about not sending you the demo on time like we agreed...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, don't worry about that!
We get that everybody has their ups and down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Exactly.
You're free to work at your own pace.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure you've been busy too.
Especially with Yuporin's dance video and all...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I'll put a rush on your song... I don't feel that well right now, so I'm not sure when it'll be complete... But I promise to finish it...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Is it those awful comments...?
Is that why you're not feeling well...?
